newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in range ahead of U.S. jobs report.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in range ahead of U.S. jobs report.

text.p: * Ringgit in range ahead of U.S. jobs data
* Ringgit trying to hold below 2.5100 a dollar
The ringgit was rangebound in early Asian trading with activity subdued ahead of the weekend and release of U.S. jobs data later on Friday, dealers said.
They said the ringgit was supported by further covering of short positions.
"There's still a bit of short covering. The market is squaring off ahead of the weekend and jobs data," said a dealer at a Malaysian bank. The market was closed on Thursday for Labour Day.
Dealers said the ringgit was trying to hold below 2.5100 a dollar after breaking through the level on Wednesday.
They said commercial buying support for the ringgit against the Singapore dollar could help the local currency.
At 0200 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5090/00 a dollar against 2.5080/90 at 1000 GMT on Thursday.
